description: Header file defining the CrashGenerationClient class for Windows crash dump generation, including methods for registration, dump requests, and pipe communication.

classes.name: CrashGenerationClient
classes.description: A class providing an interface for out-of-process crash dump generation on Windows, managing registration, dump requests, and IPC communication.

methods.name: CrashGenerationClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the crash generation client with pipe name or handle, dump type, and custom info.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers the client process with the crash server.

methods.name: RequestUpload
methods.description: Requests upload of a previous dump by crash ID.

methods.name: RequestDump
methods.description: Requests dump generation with exception or assertion info.

methods.name: DuplicatePipeToClientProcess
methods.description: Duplicates a pipe handle into another process.
